# Benchmarks

Measurements recorded on an Apple M4 Max (macOS arm64, `RUSTFLAGS="-C target-cpu=native"`, `RustyAlloc` wrapped by `CountingPeakAlloc`). Timing and hardware counter values are medians across three rounds; memory values report the maximum peak live bytes and retained scratch bytes observed across rounds.

Each cell reports:
`MB/s; p50 ns; p95 ns; instructions/call; cycles/call; allocs/call; req B/call; peak live B + retained B = max overhead B`

## Reproducing

```sh
# Fetch external corpora (twitter, citm_catalog, canada, github_events, apache_builds)
bench/data/fetch.sh

# General corpora (3 rounds)
OUT=general.tsv bench/compare.sh 3 > general.md

# Differential verification gates
cd bench/harness
cargo build --release -j 4
DIFF=30000 ./target/release/jmax-harness | md5sum          # 6715c04f984ed8838a4f1678ced61116
NODUP=1 DIFF=3000 ./target/release/jmax-harness | md5sum   # bb107953a10f4344c43003d1964bf341

# Native Binance payloads
cd ../native
cargo build --release -j 4
./target/release/time > native.tsv
./tables.sh native.tsv
```
